notes.title: Patch v3.0 is out now!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/e34962edb46160eef9deda40e6f038b868b0cac2.png"][/img][/p][h2]New patch resolving game issues! Version 3.0 is now available for download![/h2][p][/p][p][b]Hello everyone! This is the AniCore Team. A lot of time has passed since the game’s release, and during this time, we’ve been receiving bug reports from you regarding various issues. We sincerely apologize for taking so long to address these problems. Significant changes have occurred in the studio since the release, affecting both the development of new games and the fixing of older ones. Stress, burnout, and so on. Unfortunately, we’re only human, and it caught up with us. HOWEVER! We’ve gathered our strength and finally fixed the game![/b][/p][p][b]Now, let’s move on to the changes! There aren’t too many, but they will allow you to comfortably complete the game.[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]The DMS bug (where you either couldn’t receive it or the game would freeze after reading the message, preventing you from continuing the story) has been fixed. We resolved this issue quite simply — now DMS messages are received and read automatically (you don’t even need to open the phone).[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Work has been done to optimize the game and slightly improve the visuals, though not too noticeably.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor bugs with mini-games have been fixed.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]We continue working on our projects and hope for your positive feedback on our efforts. In turn, we will do our best to delight you with new games and hot content![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Best regards,  [/b][/p][p][b]AniCore Team![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]ADD TO YOUR WISHLISTS OUR FUTURE GAMES:[/u][/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576330/Hentai_Tavern/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576110/Memories_with_You/?curator_clanid=41585176"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Why is Summer For You being moved to January 24th? + Feedback New Build 0.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/4f77b2ae945f0e61dfe1551b83170d6f0059e4e6.png[/img]
Hi! We released 0.5 demo last week, so we would appreciate it if you could leave your feedback on the new version of our game in a special 📝 [u][b][url=https://forms.gle/jezpDesdGPZnUdam8]Google Form[/url][/b][/u] 📝

[h3][b]And we're still collecting wishlists for our game, so this is the 1000000th link for you 🙂🙂🙂[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980/Summer_For_You

Today we want to tell you more about the reason for postponing the full release of our game to January 24th, 2025. Many of you probably remember that we planned the release on December 13th (and at one time even on October 25th), but now the date has changed 2️⃣4️⃣❄️

[i]Releases are often postponed in our favorite area of gamedev, and some players are not happy about it for obvious reasons. Developers are usually challenged with a dilemma:[/i]
[olist][*] Release a game on time, but not perfectly (and then run into negative reviews because of it) ⏱️
[*] Postpone the release of a game to make a nice game (there will still be hate because of the postponement) 🚧[/olist]
That is the dilemma that has no perfect solution. In either of these outcomes, there will be a number of dissatisfied players; losses due to a delayed release or losses due to the poor technical state of the game, as a result of which potential customers will not want to buy the product.

[h3][b]WHAT IS YOUR PRIORITY? The first or the second option? Leave your opinion in the comments, we want to hear the opinions of our fans 💗[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/ca3109d9f16cd0c76836b20ef4cea00904129f5a.png[/img]

[h3][b]So why did we need to postpone the game's release as many as 2 times? 3 main reasons:[/b][/h3]
[olist][*] Large amount of artwork planned. And we mean not only scenes and character models, but also various cut-scenes, erotic cards, scene animations.
[*] Game mechanics. We decided to rework some mechanics after feedback from players. It took a lot of time + we need additional time to build the whole project with all the content.
[*] Debugging the game for errors and optimization. [u][b]IT IS VERY IMPORTANT FOR US THAT OUR GAME SHOULD BE PLAYED CORRECTLY!!![/b][/u][/olist]
Therefore, the decision to reschedule was difficult, but we prioritize the quality of the game over the speed of development. Yes, for financial reasons it would be better for us to release the game in December, during the peak of sales. But it would have affected the players' opinion about the technical state of the game and in the future would have turned into a disadvantage.

[h1][b]QUALITY ABOVE ALL 🤌💯✔️[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980/Summer_For_You

[h2][b]Soon our Discord server will be giving away Steam Keys for various games in honor of Christmas 🎄[/b][/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/3RGwtZBXKC  style=button] [h3] Join our Discord [/h3] [/url]

notes.title: New Halloween Build 0.4 + Alicia's Creepy Story 🎃
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/ab4f2ca3b75076999fb406f22900311c1a8443c4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]🎃 Happy Halloween everyone, my dear immortal players 🎃[/b][/h3]

Today in honor of the holiday I bring my gift - a new build 0.4 🎁 This version has a variety of changes, both cosmetic and important! Also I prepared another gift for you - Special FREE Wallpapers on Halloween theme!

[i]Halloween will come tonight:
Don’t be frightened — it’s all right
To see witches in the air —
They wish luck and do not scare![/i]

[h3][b]PLAY DEMO HERE:[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148070/Summer_For_You_Demo

[h3][b]Changelog 0.4:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] New game menu in honor of the Halloween holiday
[*] New mini-game of cooking (instead of 2048)
[*] Easy watching of H-scenes in the gallery
[*] Fixed various bugs with quests
[*] Fixed bugs with saving and loading save[/list] [i]You can also put FREE holiday wallpapers with my characters on your desktop! The wallpapers are in the game folder 📁[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/6be1022f8a4b1c1c5506111779cc361088747406.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/d838a7ba182daa90104f1a973e967d287d702cc0.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]✅ Add my adorableness to your wishlist! My game has already reached 20,000 whishlists, now we are all together aiming for the cosmic goal of 30,000 ✨[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980/Summer_For_You

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/78cb8c316eae006ad144b8d3165597e234bc7eac.png[/img]

[h3][b]And now I'm going to tell one creepy story about Alicia, our sexy witch 🩸[/b][/h3]

1692. There's a Salem witch hunt underway. Our Alicia was in trouble: she was living in New England in those days, and the hunters decided to come for her soul. They knew that Alicia was a really dangerous witch, as opposed to many of the other innocently injured women in that court.

October 30th. Evening. She sees seven thugs approaching her hut. There is no retreat. She will have to use her power again... not to create, but to protect. That's the fate of witches: to destroy other people's lives to save their own 🔪🔪🔪🔪🔪🔪🔪👩🏻‍🦰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132261/11897cc06f151831b07abcd9162c84823f15990e.jpg[/img]

[list][*] 🔪 👩🏻‍🦰 👻 = 💀
[*] 🔪 🦉 🦇 = 🥀
[*] 🔪 👩🏻‍🦰 🔥 = 🕯️
[*] 🔪 🔪 💃 ⚔ = 🪦 🪦
[*] 🔪 🧛🏻 🩸 = ⚰️
[*] 🔪 👩🏻‍🦰 👉👌 = 🖤[/list] [i]“So, you, gentlemen, come to a lady without a present. You shouldn't spoil the mood on a holiday. Otherwise you'll end up in the bloody garden”[/i]

notes.content:

[b]Hey there, gamers! 🔥🔥🔥🔥 I have some fiery news 🔥🔥🔥🔥[/b]
The demo's Steam release is close! And not just a demo, but a new build 0.3, with new content and other changes 💪 This build will participate in the Demo Festival on Steam from the 14th of October, so I would be very grateful if you launch the game both today and on the 14th-15th to support my project 🙏

[h2][b]All available content in the Steam version:[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Prologue + cutscenes
[*] 3 routes: Misha, Naomi and Samantha
[*] Choices and concequences
[*] 3 beautiful H-scenes
[*] 3 minigames (quiz, 2048 and a rhythm game)
[*] Erotic cards
[*] Messenger mechanic
[*] Open world with a handful of locations
[*] Localizations: English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, LatAm Spanish, Brazillian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Turkish[/list]
[h2][b]You can leave feedback on the demo version here:[/b] [u][b][url=https://forms.gle/K1Hp3zRcMvKTj5kUA]LINK[/url][/b][/u][/h2]

[*] 3 levels of undress on Samantha's model
[*] H-scene with Samantha
[*] Quest journal
[*] Erotic cards
[*] Messenger fixes
[*] Emotions are now voiced
[*] Various bug fixes
[*] New localization: French[/olist]

[u][b]ANOTHER IMPORTANT PIECE OF NEWS:[/b][/u] I've decided to delay the release until December 2024 bc I still need time for development. I wanted to release the game as fast as I could, but in the process of making it I realized that I want to make something more than "a simple game" - I want to make "a cool game" that you'll like and remember 💘 I hope you understand my wish - I will not let you down!
